name: mirr-wasm
description: WASM bindings for the MIRR compiler

scripts.rwfi2:compat: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const cands=['mirr_wasm.js','paper/demos/mirr_wasm.js'];const p=cands.find(x=>fs.existsSync(x));if(!p){throw new Error('missing mirr_wasm.js in '+process.cwd());}const s=fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8');for(const n of ['compile_target','compile_verilog_with_options','compile_json_netlist']){if(!s.includes('function '+n)){throw new Error('missing export '+n);}}"
